title: Chapter 109 God'S Might Like A Prison
content:
Chapter 109 God'S Might Like A Prison

The people of these tribes are the most clear about the earth-shattering, earth-shattering power of the Shendi!

Because they have personally experienced that in a battle with the Ryan Kingdom, the leader's tribe was almost broken. When the situation was critical, the God Edel of the Edel tribe came to help at a critical moment.

The mighty power of God Edel is still clearly remembered by the people of these tribes.

It was just the hand that was full of holiness, and a little golden light appeared in the hand, pointing down towards the army of the Ryan Kingdom.

The golden light continued to expand and increase as it got closer and closer to the soldiers of the Ryan Kingdom, and finally expanded enough to cover the golden light of the entire Ryan Kingdom's army formation.

Then, there was no more, the tens of thousands of Ryan Kingdom soldiers were turned into ashes with this light finger, and they were scattered on the battlefield in front of the eyes of all the tribesmen.

After that, all the tribal warriors who participated in that war became more and more afraid of the majesty of the leader, and even more awed and respected the clan god of the leader and the clan gods enshrined by their own tribes.

These tribes were afraid that their own disrespect would attract powerful gods from other tribes, as well as their own tribal gods, to punish them.

Therefore, I ordered and admonished the people of my own tribe several times. When facing the gods, whether it is the gods of small tribes or the gods of large tribes, they must maintain respect, to show the difference between mortals and gods, and to respect those gods.

Now, seeing the golden light in front of them, the people of these small tribes don't know that the gods of the Woge tribe have made a move.

On the entire plain, no matter which of the tribes under the command of the three parties, they all know that the powerful creatures that can emit golden light are all gods.

This kind of divine mansion is not enshrined by those small tribes. It can only emit some pale white, at most thick white to ordinary ancestor spirits.

Instead, it has some characteristics of the divine mansion, and in a certain sense it can be called an immortal, eternal existence.

Unless they are killed by someone stronger than him, time will never erase their lives. It can be said that they are completely different from those ordinary things.

For this kind of existence, the existence that has the characteristics of gods, but does not have gods as the fundamental godhead, is called a demigod by people.

And those deities who already belonged to godheads and were true gods also acquiesced to this title. From this aspect, it can also be seen that these demigods are special and powerful.

All the tribal warriors in front of them who took refuge in Yuguo, but were forced by the shameless Yuguo people, and had no choice but to go to the battlefield, all of them changed their expressions after the golden light appeared, and they couldn't help but backed away.

Even those supervising teams behind them? Killing a few people couldn't stop their desire to flee, and even aroused some radical people who already had a heart of resentment towards Yuguo, and killed several supervisor teams, causing further chaos.

Sun Jian and several generals around him naturally knew about the behavior of those tribal cannon fodder in front of them, although he was also curious about what that golden light in the sky was?

But as a commander, the soldiers under his command escaped and even dared to kill the supervising team, which was undoubtedly a great challenge to his majesty and the rules of the army.

Therefore, he was furious at the moment, and was about to give a token to let Huang Gai under his command lead a crossbow army, plus some elites, to suppress this chaotic army!

So that all soldiers can understand that military orders must not be violated, and military laws must not be disrupted. Those who violate the law have only one way to go: death.

Otherwise, which soldier will go to the battlefield in the future? Thinking that someone escaped ahead and was not punished, why can't I escape? Am I stupid to waste my life in this siege battle for nothing?

Once this kind of idea appears, how can the middle maintain the operation of the army? How to maintain his majesty as a commander, how to lead these soldiers to serve him!

Therefore, these soldiers must be punished. Huang Gai has just received the token, and is about to go to collect soldiers and horses, and punish those deserters properly, so as to correct the military law.

But he was horrified to find that the golden light in front of him slowly dissipated, and instead appeared a god-man in golden armor shining with golden brilliance. Can't help but kneel down and surrender.

And then, what the Golden Armored God of War did made everyone on the battlefield lose their voices and lose their minds.

I saw the god-man's right hand pointing in the direction of the fleeing barbarian, and a golden spot of light appeared on the tip of the index finger.

As the golden light spot appeared longer, it slowly condensed and concentrated, until the eyes of all those who looked at the light spot were stung, and they dared not go any further.

With the light flick of the man of God, the light spot slowly flew towards the direction of the barbarian's deserter.

The light spot looks very slow, but it is actually extremely fast. It came to the camp of the barbarian deserters in the blink of an eye, and as it got closer and closer to the barbarian deserters.

The size is also rapidly expanding, gradually becoming a huge mask covering all the barbarians, until with a click, this net-like mask firmly locks all the barbarians.

Immediately afterwards, under the expressions of fear and despair of all the barbarian deserters.

The entire light slowly became extremely golden, as if it was about to release something, and with the complete burst of golden light, it enveloped all places in the entire mask.

After that, except before the mask exploded, there was still sound coming from inside the mask, but after the explosion, no sound could be heard, and nothing could be seen.

After a while, it seems to be a few seconds, it seems to be a few minutes? The golden light inside the mask dissipated, and the mask gradually faded, and then it was blown by the wind, dissipating invisibly.

As for the barbarians and deserters inside the mask, the deserters had disappeared, only the dust blown up by the wind seemed to indicate that they were the ashes of those barbarian deserters.

Seeing the terrifying but beautiful scene of massacre in front of them, and the fate of those barbarians who deserted, Sun Jian and others thought of a word, and they were ashamed.

Isn't this word very appropriate to describe the scene in front of you? In the past, it was just words that they read from the book to express hatred for a person, but now it really happened in front of them, filling them with a different kind of taste.

Immediately afterwards, those barbaric demises, which brought emotion to people, did not last too long.

Following the horrified eyes of the Yuguo soldiers, the golden armored war god in the sky raised his hand again.

The direction of the hand was still pointing towards him, and in the middle of the finger, there was once again a condensed spot of light.

The imperial soldiers who had just seen that horrible scene were so horrified that their hands and feet were trembling, their whole body was cold, their teeth were chattering, and they wanted to turn around and run away!

But I found that I couldn't move my body at all, and I was so frightened that I lost my sense of autonomy.

But the golden-armored godman didn't release the golden dot immediately, but slowly opened his mouth to the blue-faced Sun Jian full of despair.
